y'all.t: pron. 你们（美国南部口语）

e.en: Hey, {y'all} want to grab tacos after the movie?
e.zh: 嘿,看完电影你们要不要一起去吃塔可?

e.en: {Y'all} better bring umbrellas because it's about to pour.
e.zh: 你们最好带上伞,马上要下大雨了。

yacht.t:
n. 游艇
v. 乘游艇出游

e.en: He rented a small {yacht} for the weekend in Monaco.
e.zh: 他在摩纳哥租了一艘小游艇过周末。

e.en: The billionaire's {yacht} was anchored just off the coast.
e.zh: 那位亿万富翁的游艇就停泊在离岸不远处。

yachting.t: n. 帆船运动；驾游艇出海

e.en: They spent the summer {yachting} along the Croatian coast.
e.zh: 他们整个夏天都在克罗地亚沿岸驾驶游艇。

e.en: {Yachting} is a popular but expensive hobby in Monaco.
e.zh: 在摩纳哥,玩游艇是一项流行但昂贵的爱好。

e.en: Dozens of luxury {yachts} were docked in the marina.
e.zh: 码头里停泊着数十艘豪华游艇。

e.en: The harbor festival featured racing {yachts} from twelve countries.
e.zh: 港口节展出了来自十二个国家的赛艇。

e.en: The veteran {yachtsman} crossed the Atlantic completely alone.
e.zh: 那位资深游艇手独自横渡了大西洋。

e.en: As a skilled {yachtsman}, he reads the wind instinctively.
e.zh: 作为一名熟练的游艇手,他凭直觉就能判断风向。

yah.t: int. 呀、切（表示嘲讽或得意）

yahoo.t:
n. 雅虎（互联网公司）
int. 好耶（欢呼声）

e.en: I still check my old {Yahoo} email account once a week.
e.zh: 我还是每周查一次旧的雅虎邮箱。

e.en: He let out a loud {yahoo} when his team scored.
e.zh: 他的球队得分时,他大喊了一声欢呼。

yahweh.t: n. 耶和华（犹太教上帝之名）

e.en: Ancient Hebrew scripture often refers to God as {Yahweh}.
e.zh: 古希伯来圣经常把上帝称作雅威。

e.en: Scholars debate the original pronunciation of the name {Yahweh}.
e.zh: 学者们对“雅威”这一名字的原始发音存在争议。

yak.t:
n. 牦牛
v. 喋喋不休

e.en: The film portrays a former {yakuza} trying to leave the gang.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一名前黑帮成员想要金盆洗手的故事。

e.en: Tattoos are often associated with the Japanese {yakuza}.
e.zh: 纹身常常让人联想到日本的极道组织。

e.en: She got into {Yale} on a full scholarship last year.
e.zh: 她去年拿到全额奖学金被耶鲁大学录取了。

e.en: The front door has a heavy {Yale} lock for extra security.
e.zh: 前门装了一把厚重的耶鲁锁,加强了安全性。

yalta.t: n. 雅尔塔（克里米亚城市）

e.en: The {Yalta} Conference shaped the post-war map of Europe.
e.zh: 雅尔塔会议重塑了战后欧洲的版图。

e.en: We visited {Yalta} during a trip along the Black Sea.
e.zh: 我们在黑海沿岸旅行时去了雅尔塔。

e.en: He bought a used {Yamaha} motorcycle for his commute.
e.zh: 他买了一辆二手雅马哈摩托车用于通勤。

e.en: My first piano was a small upright {Yamaha}.
e.zh: 我的第一架钢琴是一台小型雅马哈立式钢琴。

e.en: Stop {yammer}ing about your day and let me think.
e.zh: 别再唠叨你今天的事了,让我静一静。

e.en: The kids {yammer} nonstop on the long car ride home.
e.zh: 孩子们在漫长的回家路上喋喋不休。

yan.t: n. 燕（中文姓氏/地名音译）

e.en: Chinese philosophy teaches that yin and {yang} balance each other.
e.zh: 中国哲学认为阴和阳相互平衡。

e.en: She is the calm {yang} to her partner's restless yin.
e.zh: 她是阳的一面,平衡着伴侣那躁动的阴。

e.en: The {Yangtze} is the longest river in all of Asia.
e.zh: 长江是整个亚洲最长的河流。

e.en: We took a cruise down the {Yangtze} through the Three Gorges.
e.zh: 我们乘游轮顺长江而下,穿越了三峡。

yank.t:
v. 猛拉、猛拽
n. 美国佬（俚语）

e.en: Don't {yank} the cord so hard or it'll break.
e.zh: 别那么用力拽电线,会扯断的。

e.en: She gave the door a sharp {yank} to open it.
e.zh: 她猛地一拉,把门拽开了。

yankee.t: n. 美国人、北方佬（俚语）

e.en: My grandfather was a proud {Yankee} from rural Vermont.
e.zh: 我祖父是来自佛蒙特乡下的一位地道的扬基人。

e.en: The {Yankee} fans cheered loudly when their team scored.
e.zh: 洋基队得分时,球迷们大声欢呼。

yap.t: v. (小狗) 尖叫地吠；瞎咧咧

yapping.t: v. 尖声吠叫；絮叨不停

e.en: The little dog kept {yapping} at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 那只小狗对每个路过的陌生人都狂吠不止。

e.en: Quit {yapping} and finish your homework before dinner.
e.zh: 别再啰嗦了,晚饭前把作业写完。

e.en: Our neighbor's {yappy} terrier barks at every leaf.
e.zh: 邻居那只爱叫的小猎犬连一片叶子都要冲着叫。

e.en: I prefer calm dogs to small {yappy} ones.
e.zh: 比起爱叫的小型犬,我更喜欢安静的狗。

yard.t: n. 院子、场地；码（长度单位）

e.en: The kids are playing soccer in the back {yard}.
e.zh: 孩子们正在后院踢足球。

e.en: This fabric costs about ten dollars a {yard}.
e.zh: 这种布料大约十美元一码。

yardage.t: n. 以码计算的长度或数量

e.en: The quarterback gained impressive {yardage} on a single play.
e.zh: 四分卫在一次进攻中推进了相当可观的码数。

e.en: Check the {yardage} required before buying fabric for curtains.
e.zh: 在买窗帘布前先确认需要多少码。

e.en: The flag was hoisted to the top of the {yardarm}.
e.zh: 旗帜被升到了帆桁的顶端。

e.en: Sailors traditionally drink only after the sun crosses the {yardarm}.
e.zh: 按传统,水手要等太阳越过帆桁后才喝酒。

e.en: The {yardman} mows our lawn every other Saturday.
e.zh: 院工每隔一个周六来给我们修剪草坪。

e.en: He worked as a {yardman} at the rail depot for years.
e.zh: 他在铁路调车场当了多年的场地工人。

e.en: The finish line is just twenty {yards} ahead of you.
e.zh: 终点线就在你前方二十码处。

e.en: Most front {yards} on this street have neat flower beds.
e.zh: 这条街上大多数前院都有整齐的花坛。

e.en: Test scores shouldn't be the only {yardstick} for student success.
e.zh: 考试分数不该是衡量学生成功的唯一标准。

e.en: She measured the table with an old wooden {yardstick}.
e.zh: 她用一把旧木尺量了量桌子。

e.en: The town of {Yarm} sits beside the River Tees.
e.zh: 亚姆镇坐落在蒂斯河畔。

e.en: We stopped in {Yarm} for lunch on our drive north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在亚姆停下来吃了午饭。

yarmouth.t: n. 雅茅斯（英国港口城市）

e.en: {Yarmouth} is a popular seaside town on England's east coast.
e.zh: 雅茅斯是英格兰东海岸一座颇受欢迎的海滨小镇。

e.en: The ferry to the Isle of Wight departs from {Yarmouth}.
e.zh: 开往怀特岛的渡轮从雅茅斯出发。

yarmulke.t: n. 犹太男子戴的圆顶小帽

e.en: He wore a small black {yarmulke} to the synagogue service.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶黑色小圆帽参加犹太会堂的礼拜。

e.en: The boy received his first {yarmulke} for his bar mitzvah.
e.zh: 男孩在成人礼上拿到了自己的第一顶犹太小帽。

yarn.t:
n. 纱线；毛线
n. 奇闻故事

e.en: She bought soft wool {yarn} to knit a winter scarf.
e.zh: 她买了柔软的羊毛线,准备织一条冬天的围巾。

e.en: Grandpa loves spinning a tall {yarn} about his navy days.
e.zh: 爷爷最爱讲他海军时期的离奇故事。

yarrow.t: n. 蓍草（一种草本植物）

e.en: Wild {yarrow} grew in clusters along the country path.
e.zh: 野生的蓍草沿着乡间小路成簇生长。

e.en: Herbalists have used {yarrow} for centuries to stop bleeding.
e.zh: 草药师几百年来一直用蓍草来止血。

yaw.t:
v. 偏航；偏离航向
n. 偏航角

e.en: They sailed a small {yawl} from Boston to Bermuda.
e.zh: 他们驾驶一艘小型双桅帆船从波士顿航行到百慕大。

e.en: The wooden {yawl} bobbed gently in the quiet harbor.
e.zh: 那艘木制双桅帆船在宁静的港湾里轻轻起伏。

yawn.t:
v. 打哈欠
n. 哈欠

e.en: I couldn't help but {yawn} during the long meeting.
e.zh: 在那场冗长的会议中,我忍不住打起了哈欠。

e.en: His new movie is honestly a complete {yawn}.
e.zh: 说实话,他的新电影无聊得让人犯困。

e.en: She {yawned} loudly and reached for another cup of coffee.
e.zh: 她大声打了个哈欠,又伸手拿了一杯咖啡。

e.en: A deep canyon {yawned} below the narrow mountain bridge.
e.zh: 一道深谷在那座狭窄的山桥下张开了大口。

yawning.t:
v. 打哈欠（进行时）
adj. 张大的

e.en: The students were {yawning} through the early morning lecture.
e.zh: 学生们在清晨的讲座上不停地打哈欠。

e.en: A {yawning} gap separated the rich from the poor.
e.zh: 贫富之间存在着一道巨大的鸿沟。

e.en: He always {yawns} loudly at the end of long meetings.
e.zh: 长会结束时,他总是大声打哈欠。

e.en: The boring documentary drew {yawns} from the entire audience.
e.zh: 那部无聊的纪录片让全场观众都哈欠连天。

yea.t:
adv. 是；赞成
n. 赞成票

e.en: {Yeadon} is a small town just outside of Leeds.
e.zh: 耶顿是利兹郊外的一个小镇。

e.en: Leeds Bradford Airport is located near the town of {Yeadon}.
e.zh: 利兹布拉德福德机场位于耶顿镇附近。

e.en: {Yeah}, I'll grab some milk on the way home.
e.zh: 好的,我回家路上顺便买点牛奶。

e.en: Oh {yeah}, I totally forgot we had plans tonight.
e.zh: 哦对,我完全忘了我们今晚有约。

e.en: This {year} has flown by faster than I expected.
e.zh: 今年过得比我预想的还要快。

e.en: She takes a long vacation once every {year} in July.
e.zh: 她每年七月都会有一次长假。

e.en: I flipped through my old high school {yearbook} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我翻看了高中时代的旧毕业纪念册。

e.en: Please sign my {yearbook} before graduation next week.
e.zh: 请在下周毕业前给我的毕业册签个名。

yearling.t: n. 一岁的动物（尤指马）

e.en: The {yearling} colt sold for half a million at auction.
e.zh: 那匹一岁的小公马在拍卖会上以五十万的价格成交。

e.en: A nervous {yearling} deer wandered into our backyard.
e.zh: 一只胆怯的一岁小鹿闯进了我们家后院。

yearly.t:
adj. 每年的
adv. 一年一次

e.en: The company holds a {yearly} retreat for all employees.
e.zh: 公司每年都为全体员工举办一次团建活动。

e.en: She gets a dental checkup {yearly} without fail.
e.zh: 她每年都雷打不动地做一次牙科检查。

e.en: Many city workers {yearn} for a quieter life in the countryside.
e.zh: 许多城市上班族都渴望乡间的宁静生活。

e.en: After months abroad, I began to {yearn} for home cooking.
e.zh: 在国外住了几个月后,我开始想念家里的饭菜。

e.en: She {yearned} for a quiet weekend after the busy week.
e.zh: 忙碌一周后，她渴望一个安静的周末。

e.en: He {yearned} to see his family back home again.
e.zh: 他渴望再次见到家乡的亲人。

yearning.t:
n. 渴望；向往
adj. 渴望的

e.en: There was a deep {yearning} in her voice when she spoke.
e.zh: 她说话时声音里带着深深的渴望。

e.en: He kept {yearning} for the simpler days of childhood.
e.zh: 他一直怀念童年那些简单的日子。

e.en: She {yearns} to travel the world after graduation.
e.zh: 她渴望毕业后去环游世界。

e.en: Every artist {yearns} for genuine recognition of their work.
e.zh: 每位艺术家都渴望自己的作品获得真正的认可。

e.en: I have lived in this city for ten {years}.
e.zh: 我在这座城市住了十年了。

e.en: The app has improved a lot over the {years}.
e.zh: 这款应用这些年来改进了很多。

e.en: Add {yeast} to the warm water and let it bubble.
e.zh: 把酵母加入温水中，让它起泡。

e.en: Bread won't rise properly without fresh {yeast}.
e.zh: 没有新鲜酵母，面包就发不起来。

e.en: The bakery had a warm, {yeasty} smell in the morning.
e.zh: 早晨面包房里飘着一股温暖的酵母香味。

e.en: This beer has a slightly {yeasty} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这款啤酒有一点酵母味的余韵。

yell.t:
v. 大叫；吼叫
n. 喊叫声

e.en: Please don't {yell} at the kids over small mistakes.
e.zh: 请不要因为小错就对孩子们大喊大叫。

e.en: I heard a loud {yell} coming from the next room.
e.zh: 我听到隔壁房间传来一声大叫。

yelling.t:
v. 大叫（进行时）
n. 喊叫

yellow.t:
adj. 黄色的
n. 黄色

yellowed.t:
v. 变黄（过去式）
adj. 发黄的

yellowing.t:
v. 发黄（进行时）
n. 黄化

yellowstone.t: n. 黄石（美国国家公园）

yells.t:
v. 大叫（yell 的三单）
n. 喊叫声

yelp.t:
v. 尖叫；惨叫
n. 短促的叫声

yelping.t: v. 尖叫（yelp 的现在分词）

yemeni.t:
adj. 也门的
n. 也门人

yemenite.t:
n. 也门人
adj. 也门的

yen.t:
n. 日元（日本货币）
n. 渴望

yer.t: pron. 你/你的（your/you 的方言）

yes.t:
adv. 是；对
n. 同意

yet.t:
adv. 还；仍然
conj. 然而

yield.t:
v. 产生；让步
n. 产量；收益

yielded.t: v. 产生；让步（yield 的过去式）

yielding.t:
adj. 顺从的；易变形的
v. 产出

yields.t:
n. 产量；收益
v. 产生（三单）

yodel.t: v./n. 真假声转换的山歌唱法

e.en: I had Greek {yoghurt} with honey for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐吃了希腊酸奶配蜂蜜。

e.en: This {yoghurt} tastes a bit too sour for me.
e.zh: 这酸奶对我来说有点太酸了。

e.en: The fridge is full of strawberry {yoghurts} for the kids.
e.zh: 冰箱里放满了给孩子们的草莓酸奶。

e.en: Most low-fat {yoghurts} contain a lot of added sugar.
e.zh: 大多数低脂酸奶都含有大量添加糖。

e.en: She trained as a {yogi} in India for two years.
e.zh: 她在印度做了两年瑜伽修行者。

e.en: An experienced {yogi} can hold this pose for minutes.
e.zh: 经验丰富的瑜伽士可以保持这个姿势好几分钟。

e.en: He practices several {yogic} breathing techniques every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上练习几种瑜伽呼吸法。

e.en: The retreat focuses on traditional {yogic} philosophy and meditation.
e.zh: 这个静修营专注于传统瑜伽哲学和冥想。

e.en: I add fresh berries to my {yogurt} every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上往酸奶里加新鲜浆果。

e.en: Frozen {yogurt} is a popular dessert in summer.
e.zh: 冻酸奶是夏天很受欢迎的甜点。

e.en: These flavored {yogurts} are on sale this week.
e.zh: 这些口味酸奶这周正在打折。

e.en: Plain {yogurts} are healthier than the sweetened ones.
e.zh: 原味酸奶比加糖的更健康。

yoke.t:
n. 牛轭；束缚
v. 连接；束缚

e.en: The oxen pulled the plough under a wooden {yoke}.
e.zh: 两头牛套着木轭拉犁。

e.en: The country finally threw off the {yoke} of foreign rule.
e.zh: 这个国家终于摆脱了外国统治的枷锁。

e.en: The city kids unfairly called him a country {yokel}.
e.zh: 城里的孩子不公平地叫他乡巴佬。

e.en: Don't dismiss him as a {yokel} just because of his accent.
e.zh: 别因为他的口音就把他当成乡下人。

e.en: We took a day trip from Tokyo to {Yokohama}.
e.zh: 我们从东京出发去横滨一日游。

e.en: {Yokohama} has one of the largest Chinatowns in the world.
e.zh: 横滨拥有世界上最大的唐人街之一。

e.en: Break the {yolk} gently and stir it into the rice.
e.zh: 轻轻戳破蛋黄，把它拌进米饭里。

e.en: The {yolk} of a free-range egg is bright orange.
e.zh: 散养鸡蛋的蛋黄是亮橙色的。

yom.t: n. 日（希伯来语「日」，多用于节日名）

yon.t:
adj. 那边的（古/方言）
adv. 在那边

yonder.t:
adv. 在那边
adj. 那边的

e.en: The old farmer pointed to the hills over {yonder}.
e.zh: 老农指向那边远处的山丘。

e.en: Look at the bright star {yonder} above the trees.
e.zh: 看那边树顶上那颗明亮的星星。

e.en: I haven't seen that movie in {yonks}.
e.zh: 我已经好久没看过那部电影了。

e.en: We've been friends for {yonks} now.
e.zh: 我们已经是多年的老朋友了。

e.en: The castle still recalls the knights of {yore}.
e.zh: 这座城堡仍让人想起昔日的骑士。

e.en: In days of {yore}, people traveled mostly on horseback.
e.zh: 在过去的岁月里，人们大多骑马出行。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the medieval city of {York}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览中世纪古城约克。

e.en: The train to {York} leaves from platform three.
e.zh: 开往约克的火车在三号站台发车。

e.en: The bowler delivered a perfect {yorker} to take the wicket.
e.zh: 投球手投出一记完美的曲线球，拿下了三柱门。

e.en: Batsmen often struggle to defend against a fast {yorker}.
e.zh: 击球手通常很难防守快速的曲线球。

yorkers.t: n. 曲膝球（yorker 的复数）

e.en: His ability to bowl accurate {yorkers} makes him dangerous.
e.zh: 他能精准投出曲线球的能力让他非常难对付。

e.en: The coach taught the team to deliver consistent {yorkers}.
e.zh: 教练教球队稳定地投出曲线球。

e.en: Her tiny {Yorkie} barks at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 她那只小约克夏对每个路过的陌生人都狂吠。

e.en: A well-groomed {Yorkie} has long, silky hair.
e.zh: 打理得当的约克夏有着长而丝滑的毛发。

yorkist.t: n. 约克家族支持者（玫瑰战争）

e.en: The {Yorkist} forces won a decisive victory at the battle.
e.zh: 约克派军队在这场战役中取得了决定性胜利。

e.en: He grew up in a strongly {Yorkist} household.
e.zh: 他在一个坚定支持约克王朝的家庭中长大。

yorks.t: n. 约克郡（Yorkshire 的缩写）

e.en: The bowler {yorks} the batsman with a brilliant delivery.
e.zh: 投球手用一记精彩的投球击中击球手的脚下。

e.en: He often {yorks} new batsmen early in their innings.
e.zh: 他常在新击球手刚上场时就用曲线球攻击。

yorkshire.t: n. 约克郡（英格兰东北部）

e.en: We toured the beautiful countryside of {Yorkshire} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们游览了约克郡美丽的乡村。

e.en: A traditional Sunday roast must include {Yorkshire} pudding.
e.zh: 传统的周日烤肉一定要配约克郡布丁。

e.en: He's a proud {Yorkshireman} who loves his local rugby team.
e.zh: 他是个自豪的约克郡人，喜爱当地的橄榄球队。

e.en: Every {Yorkshireman} I've met has a strong regional accent.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个约克郡人都带有浓重的地方口音。

yoruba.t: n. 约鲁巴人；约鲁巴语

e.en: She is learning {Yoruba} to connect with her heritage.
e.zh: 她正在学习约鲁巴语以了解自己的文化根源。

e.en: {Yoruba} culture has a rich tradition of music and dance.
e.zh: 约鲁巴文化有着丰富的音乐和舞蹈传统。

yosemite.t: n. 优胜美地（美国国家公园）

e.en: We hiked to the top of a waterfall in {Yosemite}.
e.zh: 我们徒步登上了优胜美地一座瀑布的顶端。

e.en: {Yosemite} is famous for its giant sequoia trees.
e.zh: 优胜美地以巨大的红杉树而闻名。

e.en: My {young} nephew loves drawing dinosaurs all day.
e.zh: 我年幼的侄子整天爱画恐龙。

e.en: She started her own company when she was very {young}.
e.zh: 她很年轻的时候就创办了自己的公司。

younger.t: adj. 更年轻的（young 的比较级）

e.en: My {younger} sister just started high school this year.
e.zh: 我妹妹今年刚上高中。

e.en: He looks much {younger} than he actually is.
e.zh: 他看起来比实际年龄年轻得多。

youngish.t: adj. 较年轻的；有点年轻的

e.en: A {youngish} man in a suit answered the door.
e.zh: 一个穿西装、看起来挺年轻的男人开了门。

e.en: The team is led by a {youngish} but experienced manager.
e.zh: 团队由一位较年轻但经验丰富的经理带领。

e.en: The {Youngs} invited us over for dinner on Saturday.
e.zh: 杨家邀请我们周六去他们家吃晚饭。

e.en: Both {Youngs} are doctors at the local hospital.
e.zh: 杨家夫妇都是当地医院的医生。

e.en: The {youngster} scored the winning goal in his first game.
e.zh: 这个小伙子在首场比赛中打入了制胜一球。

e.en: Every {youngster} on the team looks up to the captain.
e.zh: 队里每个年轻球员都很敬重队长。

youngsters.t: n. 年轻人们（youngster 的复数）

e.en: The park is full of {youngsters} playing after school.
e.zh: 公园里满是放学后玩耍的孩子们。

e.en: These {youngsters} are the future of our company.
e.zh: 这些年轻人是我们公司的未来。

e.en: Please remember to bring {your} laptop to the meeting.
e.zh: 请记得把你的笔记本电脑带到会议上。

e.en: I really enjoyed reading {your} latest blog post.
e.zh: 我非常喜欢看你最近的那篇博客。

e.en: This umbrella is mine, and that one is {yours}.
e.zh: 这把伞是我的，那把是你的。

e.en: The decision is entirely {yours} to make.
e.zh: 这个决定完全由你来做。

e.en: Be kind to {yourself} when things get stressful.
e.zh: 压力大的时候，请对自己好一点。

e.en: You should try the cake {yourself} before judging it.
e.zh: 你应该先自己尝尝这蛋糕再做评价。

e.en: Please help {yourselves} to coffee and snacks at the back.
e.zh: 请到后面自取咖啡和点心。

e.en: You two should be proud of {yourselves} for finishing it.
e.zh: 你们俩完成了这件事，应该为自己感到骄傲。

e.en: Are {yous} all coming to the party tonight?
e.zh: 你们今晚都来参加聚会吗？

e.en: He asked if {yous} wanted anything from the shop.
e.zh: 他问你们要不要从商店带点什么。

e.en: He spent his {youth} traveling across Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 他年轻时游历了整个东南亚。

e.en: The program supports {youth} from low-income neighborhoods.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助来自低收入社区的青少年。

youthful.t: adj. 年轻的；朝气蓬勃的

e.en: She still has a {youthful} energy despite her age.
e.zh: 尽管上了年纪，她依然充满年轻的活力。

e.en: His {youthful} appearance often surprises new clients.
e.zh: 他年轻的外表常让新客户感到惊讶。

e.en: She dressed {youthfully} in jeans and a bright sweater.
e.zh: 她穿着牛仔裤和亮色毛衣，打扮得很年轻。

e.en: He laughed {youthfully} at his grandson's silly jokes.
e.zh: 他像年轻人一样为孙子的傻笑话开怀大笑。

e.en: Daily exercise helps her maintain a sense of {youthfulness}.
e.zh: 每日锻炼帮助她保持年轻的感觉。

e.en: The brand markets its products by emphasizing {youthfulness}.
e.zh: 该品牌通过强调年轻感来推销产品。

yowl.t:
v. 长声嚎叫
n. 嚎叫声

e.en: The cat let out a long {yowl} from the rooftop.
e.zh: 那只猫在屋顶上发出长长的嚎叫。

e.en: I heard a stray dog {yowl} outside my window.
e.zh: 我听到一只流浪狗在窗外嚎叫。

ypres.t: n. 伊普尔（比利时城市）

e.en: My great-grandfather fought in the trenches near {Ypres}.
e.zh: 我曾祖父曾在伊普尔附近的战壕里作战。

e.en: We visited the war memorial at {Ypres} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天我们参观了伊普尔的战争纪念馆。

yts.t: n. 英国青年培训计划（Youth Training Scheme）

yttrium.t: n. 钇（化学元素，符号 Y）

e.en: {Yttrium} is used in LED lights and laser technology.
e.zh: 钇被用于LED灯和激光技术中。

e.en: Scientists discovered {yttrium} in a Swedish village's mineral.
e.zh: 科学家在瑞典一个村庄的矿石中发现了钇。

e.en: The dinner cost about two hundred {yuan} per person.
e.zh: 晚餐每人大约花了两百元人民币。

e.en: Many tourists exchange dollars for {yuan} upon arrival.
e.zh: 许多游客抵达后会把美元换成人民币。

yucatecan.t:
adj. 尤卡坦（半岛）的
n. 尤卡坦人

e.en: We tried authentic {Yucatecan} cuisine at a small restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家小餐馆尝了正宗的尤卡坦菜。

e.en: {Yucatecan} dishes often feature achiote and citrus flavors.
e.zh: 尤卡坦菜常以胭脂树和柑橘风味为特色。

yucky.t: adj. 恶心的，令人作呕的

e.en: The kid pushed the broccoli aside and called it {yucky}.
e.zh: 那孩子把西兰花推到一边,说它真恶心。

e.en: There's something {yucky} stuck to the bottom of my shoe.
e.zh: 我的鞋底粘着什么恶心的东西。

yugoslav.t:
n. 南斯拉夫人
adj. 南斯拉夫的

e.en: My grandfather served as a {Yugoslav} diplomat in the 1970s.
e.zh: 我祖父在1970年代担任过南斯拉夫外交官。

e.en: The museum exhibits classic {Yugoslav} films from the postwar era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出战后时期经典的南斯拉夫电影。

yugoslavia.t: n. 南斯拉夫（已解体国家）

e.en: {Yugoslavia} broke apart into several independent countries during the 1990s.
e.zh: 南斯拉夫在1990年代解体成了几个独立国家。

e.en: My mother grew up in {Yugoslavia} before moving to Canada.
e.zh: 我母亲在搬去加拿大之前是在南斯拉夫长大的。

yugoslavian.t:
adj. 南斯拉夫的
n. 南斯拉夫人

e.en: The chef prepared a traditional {Yugoslavian} stew for dinner.
e.zh: 那位厨师为晚餐做了一道传统的南斯拉夫炖菜。

e.en: He still speaks with a slight {Yugoslavian} accent.
e.zh: 他说话仍带有一点轻微的南斯拉夫口音。

e.en: We drove through the {Yukon} during the gold rush tour.
e.zh: 我们在淘金之旅中开车穿越了育空地区。

e.en: Winter temperatures in the {Yukon} can drop below minus forty.
e.zh: 育空地区冬季气温可能降到零下四十度以下。

e.en: The family gathered around the fire to celebrate {Yule}.
e.zh: 一家人围坐在炉火旁庆祝圣诞佳节。

e.en: We baked a traditional {Yule} log for Christmas dessert.
e.zh: 我们烤了一个传统的圣诞树根蛋糕作为甜点。

e.en: The town square was decorated with {yuletide} lights and wreaths.
e.zh: 小镇广场装饰着圣诞节的彩灯和花环。

e.en: Carolers spread {yuletide} cheer through the snowy neighborhood.
e.zh: 颂歌团在白雪皑皑的街区传递着圣诞的欢乐。

e.en: These chocolate cookies are absolutely {yummy} straight from the oven.
e.zh: 这些巧克力曲奇刚出炉时简直太好吃了。

e.en: Mom made a {yummy} pasta dish with fresh basil.
e.zh: 妈妈做了一道加新鲜罗勒的美味意面。

yuppie.t: n. 雅皮士（都市白领青年）

e.en: That cafe is full of {yuppies} working on laptops.
e.zh: 那家咖啡店里全是抱着笔记本电脑工作的雅皮士。

e.en: He's become a real {yuppie} since landing the consulting job.
e.zh: 自从找到那份咨询工作后,他就成了个十足的雅皮士。

yuppies.t: n. 雅皮士们（yuppie 复数）

e.en: The neighborhood is overrun with young {yuppies} buying old houses.
e.zh: 这片街区到处都是抢购老房子的年轻雅皮士。

e.en: Trendy brunch spots cater mostly to {yuppies} on weekends.
e.zh: 那些时髦的早午餐店周末主要服务于雅皮士群体。

e.en: He drives a fancy SUV like a typical {yuppy}.
e.zh: 他开着一辆豪华SUV,完全是个典型的雅皮士。

e.en: The bar attracts a {yuppy} crowd after work hours.
e.zh: 那家酒吧下班后会吸引一群雅皮士前来。

e.en: We spent the night in a heated {yurt} on the steppe.
e.zh: 我们在草原上一座带暖气的蒙古包里过了一夜。

e.en: The campground rents out {yurts} for families on weekends.
e.zh: 那个营地周末会向家庭出租蒙古包。

yachtsmen.t: n. 游艇驾驶者, 游艇所有者

yaks.t: n. 牦牛, 饶舌, 连篇废话\nvi. 饶舌, 喋喋不休, 放声大笑

yams.t: n. 山药, 薯蓣\n[医] 薯蓣属植物

yapped.t: vi. 狂吠, 瞎扯, 责骂\nn. 狂吠, 狂吠声, 废话, 乖戾的人

yaws.t: vi. (船)偏荡, 偏航\nn. 偏航, 偏荡, 摇首

yawing.t: vi. (船)偏荡, 偏航\nn. 偏航, 偏荡, 摇首

yawed.t: vi. (船)偏荡, 偏航\nn. 偏航, 偏荡, 摇首

yeas.t: n. 肯定, 赞成, 赞成票\n[法] 赞成票, 投赞成票者, 赞成者

yeomen.t: n. 自由民, 自耕农\n[法] 小地主, 自耕农, 自由民

yips.t: n. 犬吠声, 叫喊声\nvi. 尖声狂吠, 尖声叫喊

yipped.t: n. 犬吠声, 叫喊声\nvi. 尖声狂吠, 尖声叫喊

yipping.t: n. 犬吠声, 叫喊声\nvi. 尖声狂吠, 尖声叫喊

yobs.t: n. 粗鲁的年轻人, 小无赖, 乡巴佬

youngest.t: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的\nn. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽

e.en: Digging the ditch was hard {yakka} in the heat.
e.zh: 大热天挖沟是很辛苦的体力活。

e.en: She said the project needed more {yakka} than talent.
e.zh: 她说这个项目需要的苦干比才华更多。

e.en: They {yakked} for hours after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们喋喋不休地聊了好几个小时。

e.en: He {yakked} about politics until everyone left.
e.zh: 他一直唠叨政治话题，直到大家都走了。

e.en: The old fence was painted a {yaller} shade.
e.zh: 那道旧栅栏被刷成了发黄的颜色。

e.en: He called the cowardly man {yaller}.
e.zh: 他把那个胆小的人叫作懦夫。

e.en: The specimen contained a tiny vein of {yamagutilite}.
e.zh: 这个标本里含有一小条山口石矿脉。

e.en: Researchers identified {yamagutilite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下鉴定出了山口石。

e.en: He wore a black {yamalka} at the ceremony.
e.zh: 他在仪式上戴了一顶黑色犹太小圆帽。

e.en: The child adjusted his {yamalka} before entering the synagogue.
e.zh: 孩子进犹太会堂前整理了一下小圆帽。

e.en: Petitioners waited outside the local {yamen}.
e.zh: 请愿者在当地衙门外等候。

e.en: The old {yamen} was later converted into a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧官署后来被改建成博物馆。

e.en: The tailor showed us a bolt of {yamma}.
e.zh: 裁缝给我们看了一匹亚麻织物。

e.en: Her jacket was made from coarse {yamma}.
e.zh: 她的夹克是用粗糙的亚麻布做的。

e.en: They dug {yamp} roots near the stream.
e.zh: 他们在溪边挖野胡萝卜的根。

e.en: The tribe roasted {yamp} as a seasonal food.
e.zh: 这个部族把野胡萝卜烤来当季节性食物。

e.en: I stopped listening after all the {ya-ta-ta}.
e.zh: 听到那些无聊废话后，我就不再听了。

e.en: The meeting was mostly {ya-ta-ta} about old problems.
e.zh: 会议大多是在唠叨那些老问题。

e.en: The children {yabber} all morning about the game.
e.zh: 孩子们整个上午都在喋喋不休地谈那场比赛。

e.en: Stop {yabbering} and help me lift this box.
e.zh: 别闲扯了，来帮我抬这个箱子。

e.en: His constant {yabbering} made it hard to concentrate.
e.zh: 他不停地喋喋不休，让人很难集中注意力。

e.en: They were {yabbering} about prices at the market.
e.zh: 他们在市场里闲扯价格的事。

e.en: She {yabbers} whenever she feels nervous.
e.zh: 她一紧张就会喋喋不休。

e.en: The radio host {yabbers} about gossip every afternoon.
e.zh: 那个电台主持人每天下午都闲扯八卦。

e.en: He caught a {yabby} in the muddy creek.
e.zh: 他在泥泞的小溪里捉到一只澳洲淡水小龙虾。

e.en: The children kept the {yabby} in a bucket.
e.zh: 孩子们把那只澳洲淡水小龙虾养在桶里。

e.en: A {yacare} rested near the riverbank.
e.zh: 一条凯门鳄趴在河岸附近休息。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {yacare} in the wetlands.
e.zh: 向导指出湿地里有一条凯门鳄。

e.en: A tall {yacca} grew beside the track.
e.zh: 小路旁长着一棵高高的澳洲草树。

e.en: The old hut was shaded by a {yacca}.
e.zh: 那间旧小屋被一棵澳洲草树遮着阴。

e.en: Every {yachtie} in the marina knew the storm was coming.
e.zh: 码头上的每个游艇手都知道暴风雨要来了。

e.en: She dressed like a wealthy {yachtie} on holiday.
e.zh: 她打扮得像个度假的有钱游艇爱好者。

yachtswoman.t: 女帆船运动员；女游艇手

e.en: The {yachtswoman} crossed the bay alone.
e.zh: 那位女帆船运动员独自横渡了海湾。

e.en: She became a respected {yachtswoman} after the race.
e.zh: 比赛之后，她成了一位受人尊敬的女游艇手。

yachtswomen.t: 女帆船运动员；女游艇手

e.en: The {yachtswomen} trained together every weekend.
e.zh: 那些女帆船运动员每个周末一起训练。

e.en: Several {yachtswomen} spoke about safety at sea.
e.zh: 几位女游艇手谈到了海上安全。

e.en: He wore a very {yachty} white jacket.
e.zh: 他穿着一件很有游艇圈风格的白夹克。

e.en: The harbor had a relaxed, {yachty} atmosphere.
e.zh: 港口有一种轻松的游艇氛围。

e.en: They could {yack} for hours about politics.
e.zh: 他们能聊政治聊上好几个小时。

e.en: I heard too much {yack} from the next table.
e.zh: 我听到隔壁桌太多喋喋不休的废话。

yacked.t: 喋喋不休地说过；闲聊过

e.en: We {yacked} about school until midnight.
e.zh: 我们一直聊学校的事聊到午夜。

e.en: He {yacked} through the whole movie.
e.zh: 他整场电影都在喋喋不休。

e.en: Their endless {yacket} filled the bus.
e.zh: 他们没完没了的闲扯声充满了公交车。

e.en: I cannot work with that {yacket} outside.
e.zh: 外面那阵喋喋不休让我没法工作。

e.en: Enough {yackety-yak}; tell me the facts.
e.zh: 废话够了，告诉我事实。

e.en: The show was full of {yackety-yak} and little news.
e.zh: 这个节目满是没完没了的废话，新闻很少。

e.en: Stop {yacking} while the teacher is speaking.
e.zh: 老师讲话时别再喋喋不休了。

e.en: Their {yacking} kept me awake all night.
e.zh: 他们的闲聊让我整晚睡不着。

e.en: He {yacks} on the phone every evening.
e.zh: 他每天晚上都在电话里聊个不停。

e.en: Her loud {yacks} annoyed everyone nearby.
e.zh: 她大声的闲扯惹恼了附近所有人。

e.en: He promised better service, {yada} yada yada.
e.zh: 他承诺会有更好的服务，诸如此类的套话。

e.en: The speech was all policy, growth, {yada}.
e.zh: 那场演讲全是政策、增长之类的空话。

e.en: Both graphs have clearly labeled {y-axes}.
e.zh: 两张图的y轴都标得很清楚。

e.en: The chart uses two {y-axes} for different units.
e.zh: 这张图使用两个y轴表示不同单位。

e.en: Plot temperature on the {y-axis}.
e.zh: 把温度标在y轴上。

e.en: The {y-axis} shows the company's annual revenue.
e.zh: y轴显示公司的年度收入。

e.en: The sensor recorded a weak {y-current} during the test.
e.zh: 传感器在测试中记录到微弱的y方向电流。

e.en: The resort offers {year-around} swimming in heated pools.
e.zh: 这家度假村全年都提供恒温泳池游泳。

e.en: They need {year-around} staff, not just summer workers.
e.zh: 他们需要全年工作的员工，而不只是暑期工。

e.en: The city grew {year-by-year} after the railway opened.
e.zh: 铁路开通后，这座城市一年一年地发展起来。

e.en: We compared the figures {year-by-year} to see the trend.
e.zh: 我们逐年比较这些数字，以了解趋势。

e.en: The company announced its {year-end} results today.
e.zh: 公司今天公布了年末业绩。

e.en: She received a small {year-end} bonus.
e.zh: 她收到了一笔小额年终奖金。

e.en: He completed a {year-long} training program abroad.
e.zh: 他在国外完成了一个为期一年的培训项目。

e.en: The museum planned a {year-long} celebration of local art.
e.zh: 博物馆策划了一场持续一年的本地艺术庆祝活动。

year-on-year.t: 同比的；与上年同期相比

e.en: Sales rose ten percent {year-on-year} in March.
e.zh: 三月份销售额同比增长了百分之十。

e.en: The report shows {year-on-year} growth in exports.
e.zh: 报告显示出口实现了同比增长。

e.en: The market is open {year-round}.
e.zh: 这个市场全年开放。

e.en: They grow vegetables in {year-round} greenhouses.
e.zh: 他们在全年运作的温室里种蔬菜。

e.en: As a {year-rounder}, she knew the island's quiet winters well.
e.zh: 作为全年居民，她很了解岛上安静的冬天。

e.en: The ski club welcomed every serious {year-rounder}.
e.zh: 滑雪俱乐部欢迎每一位常年参加活动的认真成员。

yearlong.t: 长达一年的；全年持续的

e.en: The school began a {yearlong} reading project.
e.zh: 学校启动了一个为期一年的阅读项目。

e.en: Their {yearlong} effort finally improved the river.
e.zh: 他们持续一年的努力终于改善了这条河。

e.en: He gave her a {yearnful} look across the room.
e.zh: 他隔着房间向她投去充满渴望的目光。

e.en: The poem has a quiet, {yearnful} tone.
e.zh: 这首诗有一种安静而思念的语调。

e.en: The two-{yearold} child was already talking clearly.
e.zh: 那个两岁大的孩子已经能清楚说话了。

e.en: A five-{yearold} car can still run very well.
e.zh: 一辆五年车龄的车仍然可以运行得很好。

e.en: The board needed a skeptic, not another {yeasayer}.
e.zh: 董事会需要一个会质疑的人，而不是又一个附和者。

e.en: He gained a reputation as a loyal {yeasayer}.
e.zh: 他有了忠实附和者的名声。

yeast-bitten.t: 受酵母影响的；有酵母味的

e.en: The brewer rejected the {yeast-bitten} batch of ale.
e.zh: 酿酒师丢弃了那批受酵母影响的麦芽酒。

e.en: The bread had a sharp, {yeast-bitten} smell.
e.zh: 那块面包有一股刺鼻的酵母味。

yeastier.t: 酵母味更重的；更起泡的

e.en: This loaf tastes {yeastier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这条面包比上一条酵母味更重。

e.en: The beer grew {yeastier} as it warmed in the glass.
e.zh: 啤酒在杯中变暖后，酵母味变得更明显。

yeastiest.t: 酵母味最重的；最起泡的

e.en: That was the {yeastiest} bread she had ever baked.
e.zh: 那是她烤过的酵母味最重的面包。

e.en: The {yeastiest} sample foamed over the rim.
e.zh: 最起泡的样品从杯沿冒了出来。

e.en: The wine had a pleasant {yeastiness} after fermentation.
e.zh: 发酵后，这款酒带有宜人的酵母味。

e.en: Too much {yeastiness} can spoil the flavor of bread.
e.zh: 酵母味过重会破坏面包的风味。

e.en: The sample contained {yeastlike} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，样本中含有酵母状细胞。

e.en: A {yeastlike} smell came from the fermenting dough.
e.zh: 正在发酵的面团散发出类似酵母的气味。

yauped.t: 大声叫喊；粗声喊叫；抱怨嚷嚷

e.en: The angry child {yauped} across the yard.
e.zh: 那个生气的孩子在院子那头大声嚷嚷。

e.en: He {yauped} about the cold soup.
e.zh: 他为那碗冷汤粗声抱怨起来。

yauper.t: 大声叫嚷的人；粗声抱怨者

e.en: The old {yauper} complained through dinner.
e.zh: 那个爱嚷嚷的老人整顿晚饭都在抱怨。

e.en: A lone {yauper} shouted from the crowd.
e.zh: 人群里有个粗声叫喊的人独自喊了起来。

e.en: His constant {yauping} annoyed the neighbors.
e.zh: 他不停地大声嚷嚷，让邻居很烦。

e.en: She heard dogs {yauping} beyond the fence.
e.zh: 她听见篱笆那边有狗在尖声叫。

e.en: They brewed tea from dried {yaupon} leaves.
e.zh: 他们用干燥的美洲冬青叶泡茶。

e.en: A hedge of {yaupon} lined the path.
e.zh: 小路旁种着一排美洲冬青树篱。

e.en: The boy {yaups} whenever he loses.
e.zh: 那个男孩一输就大声嚷嚷。

e.en: Her bitter {yaups} filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 她刺耳的抱怨声充满了厨房。

yautia.t: 芋薯；热带食用块茎植物

e.en: The stew included chunks of {yautia}.
e.zh: 炖菜里有几块芋薯。

e.en: Farmers grow {yautia} in the wet fields.
e.zh: 农民在潮湿的田里种植芋薯。

yaw-meter.t: 偏航仪；测量偏航的仪表

e.en: The pilot checked the {yaw-meter} before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员起飞前检查了偏航仪。

e.en: A faulty {yaw-meter} confused the test crew.
e.zh: 故障的偏航仪让测试人员判断混乱。

e.en: The unstable drone was a persistent {yawer}.
e.zh: 那架不稳定的无人机总是不断偏航。

e.en: Engineers studied each {yawer} in the wind tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在风洞中研究每个会偏航的模型。

yawey.t: 容易偏航的；左右摇摆的

e.en: The old canoe felt {yawey} in the current.
e.zh: 那条旧独木舟在水流中显得容易左右摆动。

e.en: A {yawey} landing worried the passengers.
e.zh: 一次左右摇摆的降落让乘客感到担心。

yawmeter.t: 偏航仪；测量偏航的仪表

e.en: The mechanic replaced the broken {yawmeter}.
e.zh: 机械师更换了坏掉的偏航仪。

e.en: Readings from the {yawmeter} changed quickly.
e.zh: 偏航仪上的读数变化很快。

yawnful.t: 令人打哈欠的；极其乏味的

e.en: The lecture was a {yawnful} hour.
e.zh: 那场讲座的一小时无聊得让人打哈欠。

e.en: He gave a {yawnful} account of the meeting.
e.zh: 他把会议讲得乏味透顶。

yawny.t: 使人打哈欠的；困倦乏味的

e.en: The movie felt slow and {yawny}.
e.zh: 那部电影节奏很慢，令人犯困。

e.en: She hid a {yawny} smile behind her hand.
e.zh: 她用手遮住一个困倦的哈欠式微笑。

yawp.t: 大声叫喊；粗声喊叫或抱怨

e.en: Do not {yawp} at me from across the room.
e.zh: 别隔着房间冲我大声嚷嚷。

e.en: His famous {yawp} sounded wild and proud.
e.zh: 他那著名的呐喊听起来狂放而自豪。

e.en: The crowd {yawped} when the lights failed.
e.zh: 灯光熄灭时，人群大声叫嚷起来。

e.en: He {yawped} for help from the riverbank.
e.zh: 他在河岸上大声呼救。

yawper.t: 大声叫嚷的人；粗声抱怨者

e.en: Every office has one tireless {yawper}.
e.zh: 每个办公室都有一个不停抱怨的人。

e.en: The street {yawper} drew a small audience.
e.zh: 街头那个大声叫喊的人吸引了一小群听众。

e.en: Stop {yawping} and explain the problem calmly.
e.zh: 别再大声嚷嚷了，冷静地说明问题。

e.en: The gulls were {yawping} above the harbor.
e.zh: 海鸥在港口上空尖声叫着。

e.en: He {yawps} whenever the rules change.
e.zh: 规则一变，他就大声抱怨。

e.en: Their rude {yawps} echoed down the hall.
e.zh: 他们粗鲁的叫喊声在走廊里回荡。

yay.t: 太好了；表示高兴的欢呼

e.en: {Yay}, we finally finished the project.
e.zh: 太好了，我们终于完成了这个项目。

e.en: The kids shouted {yay} when school ended.
e.zh: 放学时，孩子们高兴地喊着太好了。

e.en: A knight {yclept} Roland entered the hall.
e.zh: 一位名叫罗兰的骑士走进大厅。

e.en: The village was once {yclept} Greenford.
e.zh: 这个村庄过去曾被称为格林福德。

e.en: A {yellow-hammer} sang from the hedge.
e.zh: 一只黄鹀在树篱上歌唱。

e.en: The old farmer called the bird a {yellow-hammer}.
e.zh: 那位老农把这种鸟叫作黄鹀。

e.en: The fisherman pointed out a {yellow-legger} near the mudflat.
e.zh: 渔夫指着泥滩附近一只黄腿鸟。

e.en: In local slang, he was called a {yellow-legger}.
e.zh: 在当地俚语里，他被称作黄腿佬。

e.en: The old paper had turned {yellow-white} with age.
e.zh: 旧纸因年代久远变成了黄白色。

e.en: She chose a {yellow-white} paint for the kitchen walls.
e.zh: 她给厨房墙面选了淡黄白色油漆。

yellowback.t: 廉价黄封面小说；黄背动物

e.en: He bought a battered {yellowback} at the station.
e.zh: 他在车站买了一本破旧的黄封面廉价小说。

e.en: The guide identified the small {yellowback} by its bright stripe.
e.zh: 向导凭那条亮纹认出了这只黄背小动物。

e.en: A broad {yellowband} marked the edge of the trail.
e.zh: 一条宽黄带标出了小路边缘。

e.en: The moth has a clear {yellowband} across each wing.
e.zh: 这种蛾每只翅膀上都有明显的黄带。

e.en: The healer scraped {yellowbark} for a bitter tea.
e.zh: 那位草药师刮下黄树皮来煮苦茶。

e.en: A stand of {yellowbark} grew beside the creek.
e.zh: 小溪旁长着一片黄皮树。

e.en: The sergeant called the deserters {yellowbellies}.
e.zh: 中士把那些逃兵骂作胆小鬼。

e.en: Several {yellowbellies} flashed under the bridge.
e.zh: 几条黄腹鱼在桥下闪过。

e.en: Don't be a {yellowbelly}; tell the truth.
e.zh: 别当胆小鬼，把真话说出来。

e.en: The child spotted a {yellowbelly} in the pond.
e.zh: 孩子在池塘里发现了一条黄腹鱼。

e.en: A {yellowbill} perched on the fence after rain.
e.zh: 雨后一只黄嘴鸟停在篱笆上。

e.en: The guide called it a {yellowbill} because of its beak.
e.zh: 向导因为它的喙而称它为黄嘴鸟。

e.en: A bright {yellowbird} landed near the window.
e.zh: 一只鲜黄的小鸟落在窗边。

e.en: She painted a tiny {yellowbird} on the card.
e.zh: 她在卡片上画了一只小黄鸟。

e.en: Choose the {yellowest} lemon from the bowl.
e.zh: 从碗里挑出最黄的柠檬。

e.en: This is the {yellowest} paint we have.
e.zh: 这是我们这里黄色最浓的油漆。

yellowhead.t: 黄头鸟；黄头的人或动物

e.en: The {yellowhead} is common in that wetland.
e.zh: 黄头鸟在那片湿地很常见。

e.en: A small {yellowhead} duck followed its mother.
e.zh: 一只黄头小鸭跟在母鸭后面。

e.en: The soil was {yellowish-brown} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后土壤呈黄褐色。

e.en: She wore a {yellowish-brown} coat to work.
e.zh: 她穿着一件黄褐色外套去上班。

e.en: We watched a {yellowlegs} feeding in shallow water.
e.zh: 我们看见一只黄脚鹬在浅水中觅食。

e.en: The birders argued whether it was a greater {yellowlegs}.
e.zh: 观鸟者争论那是不是大黄脚鹬。

e.en: A masked {yellowthroat} sang from the reeds.
e.zh: 一只带黑面纹的黄喉鸟在芦苇中鸣叫。

e.en: She added the {yellowthroat} to her bird list.
e.zh: 她把黄喉地莺记进了自己的观鸟清单。

e.en: The field was full of {yellowtop} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天田野里长满了黄顶草。

e.en: The bottle has a {yellowtop} for easy sorting.
e.zh: 这个瓶子有黄色瓶盖，便于分类。

e.en: She collects nineteenth-century {yellowware}.
e.zh: 她收藏十九世纪的黄釉陶器。

e.en: The kitchen shelf held bowls of old {yellowware}.
e.zh: 厨房架子上放着几只旧黄陶碗。

e.en: The pasture was dotted with {yellowweed}.
e.zh: 牧场上点缀着黄花杂草。

e.en: Farmers pulled {yellowweed} before it went to seed.
e.zh: 农民在黄草结籽前把它拔掉。

e.en: A tall {yellowwood} shaded the old road.
e.zh: 一棵高大的黄木树给旧路遮阴。

e.en: The cabinet was made from polished {yellowwood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光黄木做成的。

e.en: The sample contained a dark crystal of {yenite}.
e.zh: 样本中含有一块深色的硅铁钙矿晶体。

e.en: Few students could identify {yenite} without a guidebook.
e.zh: 没有指南书，很少有学生能认出叶尼石。

e.en: She felt a {yenn} for the sea.
e.zh: 她对大海有一种强烈的向往。

e.en: His old {yenn} for travel returned.
e.zh: 他过去对旅行的念想又回来了。

e.en: The neighbor was a cheerful {yenta} who knew everything.
e.zh: 那位邻居是个快活又爱管闲事的女人，什么都知道。

e.en: His aunt played {yenta} at every family dinner.
e.zh: 他姑妈每次家庭聚餐都要热心撮合别人。

yentas.t: 爱管闲事的女人们；媒婆们

e.en: The village {yentas} spread the news by noon.
e.zh: 村里的那些爱管闲事的女人到中午就把消息传开了。

e.en: Three {yentas} tried to find him a wife.
e.zh: 三个媒婆似的人想给他找个妻子。

e.en: The {yeomenry} supplied cavalry in wartime.
e.zh: 战时义勇骑兵部队提供骑兵力量。

e.en: Historians studied the rural {yeomenry}.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了乡村自耕农阶层。

e.en: She shouted {yeow} after stubbing her toe.
e.zh: 她踢到脚趾后大喊了一声哎哟。

e.en: The cat gave a sharp {yeow}.
e.zh: 那只猫发出一声尖厉的叫声。

e.en: He tried to {yerk} the rope free.
e.zh: 他试图猛地一拉把绳子拽开。

e.en: The mule would {yerk} at the reins.
e.zh: 那头骡子会猛扯缰绳。

e.en: She {yerked} the door open.
e.zh: 她猛地把门拉开。

e.en: The rider {yerked} the reins hard.
e.zh: 骑手用力猛拉缰绳。

e.en: He was {yerking} the chain impatiently.
e.zh: 他不耐烦地猛拉着链子。

e.en: The sudden {yerking} hurt my shoulder.
e.zh: 那一下突然的猛拽弄疼了我的肩膀。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed him with {yersiniosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有耶尔森菌病。

e.en: Contaminated pork can cause {yersiniosis}.
e.zh: 受污染的猪肉可能引发耶尔森菌病。

e.en: The manager promoted a loyal {yes-man}.
e.zh: 经理提拔了一个忠心的应声虫。

e.en: Nobody trusts a {yes-man} in debates.
e.zh: 辩论中没人信任只会附和的人。

e.en: The board was full of {yes-men}.
e.zh: 董事会里全是唯唯诺诺的人。

e.en: Leaders need critics, not {yes-men}.
e.zh: 领导者需要批评者，而不是应声虫。

e.en: The proposal received twenty {yeses}.
e.zh: 这项提案获得了二十张赞成票。

e.en: Her inbox contained several {yeses}.
e.zh: 她的收件箱里有几个同意的答复。

e.en: He studied scripture at a {yeshivah}.
e.zh: 他在一所犹太教经学院学习经文。

e.en: The old {yeshivah} served the community.
e.zh: 那所老犹太教经学院服务着当地社群。

e.en: He refused to be a {yesman}.
e.zh: 他拒绝做一个只会附和的人。

e.en: A {yesman} rarely challenges bad ideas.
e.zh: 应声虫很少质疑糟糕的想法。

e.en: Dictators surround themselves with {yesmen}.
e.zh: 独裁者身边常围着一群应声虫。

e.en: The team needed experts, not {yesmen}.
e.zh: 这个团队需要专家，而不是唯唯诺诺的人。

e.en: {Yess}, that answer is correct.
e.zh: 是的，那个答案是正确的。

e.en: She whispered {yess} with relief.
e.zh: 她如释重负地低声说了句是的。

e.en: {Yessir}, the car is ready.
e.zh: 是的，先生，车已经准备好了。

e.en: The recruit answered {yessir} immediately.
e.zh: 那名新兵立刻回答遵命。

e.en: Brewers used {yest} to ferment ale.
e.zh: 酿酒师用酵母来发酵麦芽酒。

e.en: White {yest} gathered on the liquid.
e.zh: 白色泡沫聚在液体表面。

e.en: The poem speaks of {yester} joys with regret.
e.zh: 这首诗带着遗憾写到昨日的欢乐。

e.en: In {yester} times, the village was smaller.
e.zh: 在往昔岁月里，这个村庄更小。

e.en: She arrived at the inn {yestereve}.
e.zh: 她昨晚到了那家客栈。

e.en: The bell rang softly at {yestereve}.
e.zh: 昨日傍晚，钟声轻轻响起。

e.en: We met by the bridge {yestereven}.
e.zh: 我们昨晚在桥边见了面。

e.en: At {yestereven}, the sky turned crimson.
e.zh: 昨日傍晚，天空变成了深红色。

e.en: I heard the news {yesterevening}.
e.zh: 我昨晚听到了这个消息。

e.en: The guests departed late on {yesterevening}.
e.zh: 客人们在昨日傍晚之后很晚才离开。

e.en: He left the farm at {yestermorn}.
e.zh: 他昨天早晨离开了农场。

e.en: By {yestermorn}, the snow had melted.
e.zh: 到昨天早晨，雪已经化了。

e.en: She wrote the letter {yestermorning}.
e.zh: 她昨天早晨写了那封信。

e.en: The road was empty on {yestermorning}.
e.zh: 昨天早晨，那条路上空无一人。

e.en: He mourned the {yestern} peace of home.
e.zh: 他怀念家中昔日的安宁。

e.en: Those {yestern} customs now seem strange.
e.zh: 那些过去的习俗如今显得陌生。

e.en: The message reached us at {yesternoon}.
e.zh: 消息在昨天中午传到了我们这里。

e.en: By {yesternoon}, the market was crowded.
e.zh: 到昨天中午，市场已经很拥挤了。

e.en: I saw him in town {yesterweek}.
e.zh: 我上周在城里见过他。

e.en: The trouble began in {yesterweek}, not today.
e.zh: 麻烦是前一周开始的，不是今天才有。

e.en: We sang together {yestreen} by the fire.
e.zh: 昨夜我们围着火一起唱歌。

e.en: The moon was bright {yestreen}.
e.zh: 昨晚月光很明亮。

e.en: Her {yet-to-be} husband was waiting outside.
e.zh: 她未来的丈夫正在外面等着。

e.en: The {yet-to-be} announced policy caused speculation.
e.zh: 那项尚未公布的政策引发了猜测。

e.en: The brewer filled a small {yetling} with ale.
e.zh: 酿酒人把一个小酒桶装满麦芽酒。

e.en: An old {yetling} stood beside the cellar door.
e.zh: 一个旧小桶放在地窖门旁。

e.en: This wool sweater makes my neck {yeuk}.
e.zh: 这件羊毛衫弄得我脖子发痒。

e.en: He had a terrible {yeuk} on his arm.
e.zh: 他胳膊上痒得厉害。

e.en: He carried a {yewen} bow into battle.
e.zh: 他带着一张紫杉木制的弓上了战场。

e.en: The old chest had {yewen} panels.
e.zh: 那个旧箱子有紫杉木镶板。

e.en: The article described a {Yezidi} community in Iraq.
e.zh: 这篇文章介绍了伊拉克的一个雅兹迪人社区。

e.en: She studies {Yezidi} religious traditions.
e.zh: 她研究雅兹迪教的宗教传统。

e.en: The children began to {yicker} behind the door.
e.zh: 孩子们在门后开始咯咯笑。

e.en: She gave a nervous {yicker} at the joke.
e.zh: 听到这个笑话，她紧张地轻笑了一声。

yid.t: 犹太人的冒犯性蔑称；慎用词语

e.en: The editor removed the slur {yid} from the article.
e.zh: 编辑从文章中删去了“yid”这个侮辱性词语。

e.en: He learned that {yid} is offensive in most contexts.
e.zh: 他了解到“yid”在大多数语境中都带有冒犯性。

e.en: The old contract mentioned the {yieldance} of certain rights.
e.zh: 那份旧合同提到了某些权利的让与。

e.en: The farmer recorded the field's {yieldance} after harvest.
e.zh: 农民在收获后记录了这块田的产出量。

yiff.t: 兽迷色情内容；相关行为

e.en: The forum banned explicit {yiff} from public channels.
e.zh: 论坛禁止在公共频道发布露骨的兽迷色情内容。

e.en: She avoided sites where {yiff} was the main topic.
e.zh: 她避开那些主要讨论兽迷色情内容的网站。

yike.t: 因惊讶或害怕而叫；惊叫

e.en: I heard him {yike} when the door slammed.
e.zh: 门砰地关上时，我听见他惊叫了一声。

e.en: The child gave a sharp {yike} in the dark.
e.zh: 孩子在黑暗中发出一声尖叫。

e.en: {Yikes}, that bill is higher than expected.
e.zh: 哎呀，那张账单比预想的高。

e.en: She whispered {yikes} when the spider appeared.
e.zh: 蜘蛛出现时，她小声说了一句吓人啊。

e.en: The frightened {yikker} woke the whole house.
e.zh: 那个受惊尖叫的人把全家都吵醒了。

e.en: Nobody knew which {yikker} had started the panic.
e.zh: 没人知道是哪一个尖叫的人引发了恐慌。

e.en: The tavern served warm {yill} in wooden cups.
e.zh: 酒馆用木杯端上温热的麦酒。

e.en: The poem praises bread, cheese, and {yill}.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美面包、奶酪和麦酒。

e.en: {Yipe}, I nearly dropped the glass.
e.zh: 哎呀，我差点把杯子掉了。

e.en: He shouted {yipe} as the bike skidded.
e.zh: 自行车打滑时，他喊了一声哎呀。

e.en: Their {yippy} little dog barked all morning.
e.zh: 他们那只爱尖叫的小狗叫了一上午。

e.en: The song has a bright, {yippy} chorus.
e.zh: 这首歌有一段明亮而尖细的副歌。

yird.t: 泥土；埋葬，古旧或方言词

e.en: The old ballad says he was laid in the {yird}.
e.zh: 那首古老民谣说他被埋入泥土之中。

e.en: Rain turned the path into dark {yird}.
e.zh: 雨水把小路变成了深色的泥地。

e.en: The engine made a low {yirr} in the shed.
e.zh: 棚里的发动机发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

e.en: A sudden {yirr} rose from the crowd.
e.zh: 人群中突然响起一阵嘈杂的咆哮声。

e.en: He stood {yirshing} in the cold wind.
e.zh: 他站在寒风中瑟瑟发抖。

e.en: The old window was {yirshing} in its frame.
e.zh: 那扇旧窗在窗框里不停颤动。

yit.t: 幼雏；小孩，方言或罕用词

e.en: The farmer found a tiny {yit} under the hedge.
e.zh: 农夫在树篱下发现了一只小雏鸟。

e.en: The old woman called the noisy child a {yit}.
e.zh: 老妇人把那个吵闹的孩子叫作小家伙。

e.en: The perfume contains notes of {ylang-ylang} and jasmine.
e.zh: 这款香水含有依兰和茉莉的香调。

e.en: They planted {ylang-ylang} near the veranda for its scent.
e.zh: 他们在阳台附近种了依兰，借它散发香气。

e.en: The physicist used {ylem} in a historical lecture.
e.zh: 物理学家在一场历史讲座中用了“宇宙原初物质”这个词。

e.en: Ancient thinkers imagined {ylem} as the source of matter.
e.zh: 古代思想家把原质想象成物质的来源。

ylid.t: 叶立德；带相反电荷的分子

e.en: The chemist synthesized an {ylid} for the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家为这次反应合成了一种叶立德。

e.en: An {ylid} can act as a useful intermediate.
e.zh: 叶立德可以作为有用的中间体。

e.en: The cottage stood on {yond} hill beyond the stream.
e.zh: 那间小屋立在溪水那边的山丘上。

e.en: He pointed to {yond} and said the road ended there.
e.zh: 他指向那边，说路在那里到头。

e.en: The sculpture used the {yoni} as a symbol of fertility.
e.zh: 这座雕塑用女性生殖器作为生育力的象征。

e.en: The text discusses the {yoni} in Hindu religious imagery.
e.zh: 这篇文本讨论印度教宗教图像中的阴户意象。

e.en: Ancient carvings sometimes depict {yonis} beside sacred symbols.
e.zh: 古代雕刻有时把阴户与神圣符号并列描绘。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {yonis} in South Asian temple art.
e.zh: 讲座提到了南亚寺庙艺术中的女性生殖器图像。

e.en: The old sailor called the cabin boy a bold {yonker}.
e.zh: 老水手把那个船舱男孩叫作大胆的小伙子。

e.en: In the old play, a foolish {yonker} wastes his inheritance.
e.zh: 在那部古老戏剧里，一个愚蠢的年轻人挥霍了遗产。

e.en: {Yoo-hoo}, is anyone upstairs?
e.zh: 喂，楼上有人吗？

e.en: She waved and called {yoo-hoo} across the garden.
e.zh: 她挥着手，隔着花园喊了一声喂。

e.en: The columnist mocked politicians trying to sound like the {yoof}.
e.zh: 专栏作家嘲笑那些试图装得像年轻人的政客。

e.en: The campaign was aimed at the {yoof} market.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动面向青年消费群体。

e.en: My wool sweater makes my neck {yook} all morning.
e.zh: 我的羊毛衫让脖子整个上午都发痒。

e.en: He could not ignore the {yook} under the bandage.
e.zh: 他无法忽视绷带下面的那阵痒感。

e.en: Is that {yor} horse by the gate?
e.zh: 门边那匹马是你的吗？

e.en: Keep {yor} hands warm in this bitter wind.
e.zh: 这种刺骨寒风里，要把你的手保暖好。

e.en: The article described {yordim} returning after years abroad.
e.zh: 文章描述了在海外多年后返回的以色列移居者。

e.en: Some Israelis debate how society should view {yordim}.
e.zh: 一些以色列人争论社会应如何看待离国移居者。

e.en: Some supplements contain {yohimbine} as a stimulant.
e.zh: 一些补充剂含有育亨宾碱作为兴奋成分。

e.en: The doctor warned that {yohimbine} can raise blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生提醒说，育亨宾碱可能会升高血压。

e.en: The rider gave a loud {yoick} to urge the hounds on.
e.zh: 骑手大声吆喝，催促猎犬继续追赶。

e.en: A sudden {yoick} echoed across the field.
e.zh: 一声突如其来的猎场吆喝在田野上回响。

e.en: The huntsman shouted {yoicks} as the dogs found the trail.
e.zh: 猎犬发现踪迹时，猎人喊出了追猎的吆喝声。

e.en: Old hunting songs still include cries of {yoicks}.
e.zh: 古老的狩猎歌曲里仍有这种猎狐吆喝声。

e.en: He looked strangely {yoiless} after hearing the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后，他却显得出奇地无忧无虑。

e.en: The poem praises a {yoiless} life in the countryside.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美乡间无忧无虑的生活。

e.en: The merchant hired a {yojimbo} for the dangerous road.
e.zh: 商人雇了一名保镖护送他走过危险的道路。

e.en: In the film, the wandering {yojimbo} plays both sides.
e.zh: 在影片中，流浪护卫周旋于双方之间。

e.en: The bird has {yoke-toed} feet adapted for climbing.
e.zh: 这种鸟有适合攀爬的轭形脚趾。

e.en: A {yoke-toed} footprint appeared in the soft mud.
e.zh: 软泥里出现了一个趾形如轭的足印。

e.en: He called his old colleague a faithful {yokefellow}.
e.zh: 他称自己的老同事为忠诚的共事伙伴。

e.en: In hard times, a true {yokefellow} shares the burden.
e.zh: 艰难时刻，真正的同伴会一起分担重担。

e.en: His {yokelish} manners embarrassed his fashionable cousins.
e.zh: 他土气的举止让那些时髦的表亲感到尴尬。

e.en: The actor used a deliberately {yokelish} accent.
e.zh: 那位演员故意用了乡下佬似的口音。

e.en: The ox pulled steadily beside its {yokemate}.
e.zh: 那头牛和同轭伙伴一起稳稳地拉着车。

e.en: She regarded him as her {yokemate} in every struggle.
e.zh: 她把他视为共同面对一切困难的伙伴。

e.en: The {yokozuna} entered the ring with solemn ceremony.
e.zh: 横纲以庄重的仪式进入相扑场。

e.en: He trained for years hoping to become a {yokozuna}.
e.zh: 他训练多年，希望成为最高级别的相扑力士。

e.en: The cake had a rich, {yolky} center.
e.zh: 这块蛋糕中间有浓厚的蛋黄般夹心。

e.en: A {yolky} stain spread across the napkin.
e.zh: 餐巾上晕开了一片像蛋黄一样的污渍。

e.en: The soldiers had to {yomp} across the moor in heavy rain.
e.zh: 士兵们不得不在大雨中负重穿越荒原。

e.en: After a long {yomp}, the unit reached the village.
e.zh: 长途负重行军后，部队抵达了那个村庄。

e.en: Every {yomper} carried food, water, and radio gear.
e.zh: 每名负重行军者都携带食物、水和无线电设备。

e.en: He was known as a tough {yomper} in the regiment.
e.zh: 他在团里以能吃苦的长途负重行军者著称。

e.en: The sailors shouted {yo-heave-ho} as they pulled the rope.
e.zh: 水手们拉绳子时喊着嘿哟号子。

e.en: With one last {yo-heave-ho}, they lifted the crate onto the cart.
e.zh: 他们最后喊了一声嘿哟，把箱子抬上了车。

e.en: The children cried {yo-ho} while pretending to be pirates.
e.zh: 孩子们假装海盗时喊着哟嗬。

e.en: A loud {yo-ho} came from the deck at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时甲板上传来一声响亮的哟嗬。

e.en: She learned a new trick with her {yo-yo}.
e.zh: 她用悠悠球学会了一个新花样。

e.en: His weight tends to {yo-yo} during stressful months.
e.zh: 压力大的几个月里，他的体重常常反复升降。

yo-yos.t: 悠悠球；反复起落的人或物

e.en: The shop sells colorful {yo-yos} near the front counter.
e.zh: 这家店在前台附近卖彩色悠悠球。

e.en: The figures behave like {yo-yos}, rising and falling every week.
e.zh: 这些数字像悠悠球一样，每周上下波动。

yobbish.t: 粗野无礼的；小流氓式的

e.en: The fans were criticized for their {yobbish} behavior after the match.
e.zh: 赛后球迷因粗野无礼的行为受到批评。

e.en: He adopted a {yobbish} swagger to impress his friends.
e.zh: 他摆出一副小流氓式的架势来逞能。

yobo.t: 丈夫；老婆对丈夫的称呼

e.en: She introduced him jokingly as her {yobo}.
e.zh: 她开玩笑地把他介绍为自己的老公。

e.en: In some Korean families, {yobo} is a warm term for a spouse.
e.zh: 在一些韩国家庭里，yobo 是对配偶的亲昵称呼。

e.en: He let out a loud {yock} at the old joke.
e.zh: 听到那个老笑话，他粗声大笑起来。

e.en: The comedian's timing made the whole room {yock}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的节奏逗得全场大笑。

e.en: The scholar pointed to the {yodh} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 学者指着手稿里的约德字母。

e.en: In transliteration, {yodh} often represents a y sound.
e.zh: 在音译中，yodh 常表示 y 的音。

e.en: The dialect shows {yodization} before certain vowels.
e.zh: 这种方言在某些元音前会出现约德音化。

e.en: Her paper explains {yodization} in historical pronunciation.
e.zh: 她的论文解释了历史发音中的约德音化。

e.en: He tried to {yodle} across the valley.
e.zh: 他试着在山谷间唱约德尔调。

e.en: The song ended with a bright {yodle}.
e.zh: 这首歌以一段明亮的约德尔唱腔结束。

e.en: She {yodled} from the hillside at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时她在山坡上唱起了约德尔调。

e.en: The chorus {yodled} a playful refrain.
e.zh: 合唱队用约德尔唱法唱了一段俏皮的副歌。

e.en: The {yodler} performed at a mountain festival.
e.zh: 那位约德尔歌手在山地节庆上表演。

e.en: A skilled {yodler} can switch pitch very quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的约德尔歌手能很快切换音高。

e.en: We heard {yodling} echo through the valley.
e.zh: 我们听见约德尔歌声在山谷里回荡。

e.en: She has been {yodling} since childhood.
e.zh: 她从小就一直在唱约德尔调。

e.en: The old manuscript uses {yogh} where modern English uses g.
e.zh: 那份古手稿在现代英语用 g 的地方使用约格字母。

e.en: Students often confuse {yogh} with the number three.
e.zh: 学生常把约格字母和数字三混淆。

e.en: She ate plain {yoghourt} with honey for breakfast.
e.zh: 她早餐吃了加蜂蜜的原味酸奶。

e.en: The recipe calls for thick {yoghourt} instead of cream.
e.zh: 这个食谱要求用浓稠酸奶代替奶油。

e.en: The old {yogin} lived simply near the river.
e.zh: 那位年长的瑜伽修行者在河边过着简朴生活。

e.en: A dedicated {yogin} practices meditation every morning.
e.zh: 虔诚的瑜伽士每天早晨练习冥想。

yogini.t: 女瑜伽修行者；女瑜伽士

e.en: The {yogini} taught breathing exercises to beginners.
e.zh: 那位女瑜伽士教初学者呼吸练习。

e.en: In the poem, a wise {yogini} guides the traveler.
e.zh: 诗中一位睿智的女瑜伽修行者引导旅人。

e.en: Several {yogins} gathered before sunrise to meditate.
e.zh: 几位瑜伽修行者在日出前聚在一起冥想。

e.en: The book describes ancient {yogins} and their disciplines.
e.zh: 这本书描写了古代瑜伽士及其修行法。

e.en: His lecture linked {yogism} with early Indian philosophy.
e.zh: 他的讲座把瑜伽教义与早期印度哲学联系起来。

e.en: She studied {yogism} as both a practice and a belief system.
e.zh: 她把瑜伽修行既作为实践也作为信仰体系来研究。

e.en: Some supplements contain {yohimbe} extract.
e.zh: 有些补充剂含有育亨宾提取物。

e.en: The doctor warned him that {yohimbe} can cause side effects.
e.zh: 医生提醒他，育亨宾可能会引起副作用。

e.en: The collector labeled the green crystal as {yoshimuraite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块绿色晶体标为吉村石。

e.en: Samples of {yoshimuraite} are rare outside specialist museums.
e.zh: 吉村石标本在专业博物馆之外很少见。

e.en: The linguist described the sound shift as {yotation}.
e.zh: 语言学家把这种语音变化称为腭化音变。

e.en: Old spellings can preserve traces of {yotation}.
e.zh: 旧拼写有时会保留加约音的痕迹。

e.en: The lecture compared {yotization} in several Slavic languages.
e.zh: 讲座比较了几种斯拉夫语言中的腭化音变。

e.en: This consonant changed through {yotization} over time.
e.zh: 这个辅音随着时间通过加约音过程发生了变化。

e.en: Are {you-all} coming to dinner tonight?
e.zh: 你们大家今晚都来吃饭吗？

e.en: Thank {you-all} for staying late.
e.zh: 谢谢各位这么晚还留下来。

e.en: The teacher wrote a {youd} on the board.
e.zh: 老师在黑板上写了一个希伯来字母约德。

e.en: In this manuscript, the {youd} is unusually small.
e.zh: 在这份手稿中，约德这个字母写得特别小。

e.en: The poem keeps {youing} the reader directly.
e.zh: 这首诗不断直接用“你”来称呼读者。

e.en: Stop {youing} me like I caused the problem.
e.zh: 别老对我说“你怎样”，好像问题是我造成的。

young-eyed.t: 眼神年轻的；目光清新的

e.en: The {young-eyed} reporter noticed every small detail.
e.zh: 那位目光清新的记者注意到了每个小细节。

e.en: He remained {young-eyed} despite decades of disappointment.
e.zh: 尽管经历了几十年的失望，他的眼神依然年轻。

young-old.t: 低龄老人；较年轻的老年人

e.en: The study focused on the {young-old} between sixty-five and seventy-four.
e.zh: 这项研究关注六十五到七十四岁之间的低龄老人。

e.en: Many {young-old} adults still work part-time.
e.zh: 许多较年轻的老年人仍在兼职工作。

e.en: What are {yuh} doing here?
e.zh: 你在这里做什么？

e.en: I told {yuh} to wait outside.
e.zh: 我叫你在外面等。

e.en: She wore a blue {yukata} to the festival.
e.zh: 她穿着蓝色浴衣去参加祭典。

e.en: The hotel provided a cotton {yukata} for each guest.
e.zh: 酒店给每位客人提供一件棉质浴衣。

yuke.t: 尤克里里的非正式拼写

e.en: He played a tiny {yuke} by the fire.
e.zh: 他在火边弹着一把小尤克里里。

e.en: She bought a cheap {yuke} online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一把便宜的尤克里里。

e.en: She {yukked} when she saw the spoiled meat.
e.zh: 她看到变质的肉时作呕了。

e.en: The kids {yukked} at the bitter medicine.
e.zh: 孩子们对那苦药直喊恶心。

e.en: He was {yukking} after tasting the sauce.
e.zh: 他尝了那酱之后直犯恶心。

e.en: They sat in the back, {yukking} all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们坐在后面，整个下午都在说笑。

e.en: The comedian got several {yuks} from the crowd.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员逗得观众笑了好几次。

e.en: Clean those {yuks} off the floor.
e.zh: 把地板上那些恶心的东西清掉。

e.en: A {yulan} bloomed beside the old gate.
e.zh: 一株玉兰在旧门旁开花了。

e.en: The garden is famous for its white {yulan}.
e.zh: 这座花园以白玉兰闻名。

e.en: The toddler said {yum-yum} after every bite.
e.zh: 小孩每吃一口都说好吃。

e.en: Those cookies look {yum-yum} to me.
e.zh: 那些饼干在我看来很好吃。

e.en: She made jam from ripe {youngberries} in July.
e.zh: 她七月用成熟的杨氏莓做果酱。

e.en: A {youngberry} tastes like a cross between blackberry and raspberry.
e.zh: 杨氏莓吃起来像黑莓和树莓的杂交味道。

e.en: The team needs some {youngblood} with fresh ideas.
e.zh: 这个团队需要一些有新想法的年轻新血。

e.en: He was the {youngblood} everyone expected to shake up the company.
e.zh: 大家都期待他这个年轻干将能给公司带来改变。

e.en: The shepherd carried a weak {youngling} back to the barn.
e.zh: 牧羊人把一只虚弱的幼崽抱回了谷仓。

e.en: The old tale warned every {youngling} to stay near home.
e.zh: 那个古老故事告诫每个小孩不要离家太远。

e.en: The old sailor called the new deckhand a bold {younker}.
e.zh: 老水手把新来的甲板工叫作大胆的少年。

e.en: In the novel, a foolish {younker} wastes his inheritance.
e.zh: 在小说里，一个愚蠢的年轻人挥霍掉了遗产。

e.en: Are {youse} coming to the match tonight?
e.zh: 你们今晚会来看比赛吗？

e.en: I told {youse} to wait outside, not in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我叫你们在外面等，不是待在厨房里。

e.en: The magazine changed to a more {youth-oriented} style.
e.zh: 这本杂志改成了更面向年轻人的风格。

e.en: Their campaign used {youth-oriented} music and short videos.
e.zh: 他们的宣传活动用了面向年轻人的音乐和短视频。

e.en: The poet imagined spring could {youthen} every tired heart.
e.zh: 诗人想象春天能让每颗疲惫的心重新年轻。

e.en: No cream can truly {youthen} the skin overnight.
e.zh: 没有哪种面霜能真的一夜之间让皮肤返老还童。

e.en: He spent his {youthhood} in a small fishing village.
e.zh: 他的青年时期是在一个小渔村度过的。

e.en: The memoir looks back on her restless {youthhood}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录回顾了她躁动不安的青春岁月。

e.en: The brand tried to {youthify} its image with streetwear ads.
e.zh: 这个品牌试图用街头服饰广告让形象年轻化。

e.en: Editors should not {youthify} every classic novel with slang.
e.zh: 编辑不该用俚语把每部经典小说都改得迎合年轻人。

e.en: She volunteers in {youthmin} at her local church.
e.zh: 她在本地教会的青年事工中做志愿者。

e.en: The conference offered training for {youthmin} leaders.
e.zh: 这场会议为青少年牧养负责人提供培训。

e.en: The healer searched the hills for rare {youthwort}.
e.zh: 那位医者在山间寻找罕见的返老草。

e.en: In the legend, {youthwort} restores an old king's strength.
e.zh: 在传说中，返老草让一位老国王恢复了力量。

e.en: The actor kept a {youthy} energy well into middle age.
e.zh: 这位演员到了中年仍保持着青春般的活力。

e.en: Her {youthy} clothes looked too casual for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她那身年轻气的衣服对典礼来说显得太随意。

e.en: She became a popular {YouTuber} after posting travel videos.
e.zh: 她发布旅行视频后成了一名受欢迎的视频博主。

e.en: The {YouTuber} reviewed three budget phones this week.
e.zh: 这位油管博主本周评测了三款平价手机。

e.en: {Yow}, that coffee is hotter than I expected!
e.zh: 哎哟，这咖啡比我想的还烫！

e.en: He shouted {yow} when the ball hit his shin.
e.zh: 球砸到他小腿时，他喊了一声哎哟。

e.en: Children whispered that a {yowie} lived beyond the creek.
e.zh: 孩子们小声说小溪那边住着澳洲传说里的野人。

e.en: The film treats the {yowie} as a mysterious forest creature.
e.zh: 这部电影把澳洲野人描写成神秘的森林生物。

e.en: The record lists him as a {yowman} with two acres.
e.zh: 记录中把他列为拥有两英亩地的自耕农。

e.en: A loyal {yowman} guarded the lord's chamber at night.
e.zh: 一名忠诚的侍从夜里守卫着领主的房间。

e.en: {Yowsah}, that trumpet solo was incredible!
e.zh: 哇，那段小号独奏太精彩了！

e.en: He opened the bill and muttered {yowsah} under his breath.
e.zh: 他打开账单，低声嘀咕了一句哇。

e.en: The child learned to spin a {yoyo} after dinner.
e.zh: 那个孩子晚饭后学会了玩悠悠球。

e.en: Prices can {yoyo} when the market is nervous.
e.zh: 市场紧张时，价格可能会上下波动。

e.en: The report identified {yperite} as the chemical agent used.
e.zh: 报告确认使用的化学剂是芥子气。

e.en: Soldiers feared {yperite} because it burned skin and lungs.
e.zh: 士兵害怕芥子气，因为它会灼伤皮肤和肺部。

e.en: The biologist drew a {ypsiliform} mark beside the specimen.
e.zh: 生物学家在标本旁画了一个Y形标记。

e.en: A {ypsiliform} crack spread across the old windowpane.
e.zh: 一道叉状裂纹在旧窗玻璃上蔓延开来。

e.en: This cake is {yummier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这个蛋糕比上一个更好吃。

e.en: The soup got {yummier} after adding herbs.
e.zh: 加了香草后，这汤变得更美味了。

yuppiedom.t: 雅皮士阶层；雅皮文化圈

e.en: The neighborhood became a symbol of {yuppiedom}.
e.zh: 这个街区成了雅皮士阶层的象征。

e.en: His novel satirizes the anxieties of {yuppiedom}.
e.zh: 他的小说讽刺了雅皮文化圈的焦虑。

e.en: Residents protested the {yuppification} of their old market.
e.zh: 居民抗议老市场被雅皮化改造。

e.en: The cafe's prices reflect the area's {yuppification}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的价格反映了该地区的中产化。

e.en: Developers tried to {yuppify} the waterfront district.
e.zh: 开发商试图把滨水区改造成雅皮化街区。

e.en: They feared the new boutiques would {yuppify} the street.
e.zh: 他们担心新开的精品店会让这条街中产化。

e.en: The proposal received several quick {yups}.
e.zh: 这个提议很快得到了几声赞同。

e.en: Her messages were mostly short {yups} and emojis.
e.zh: 她的信息大多只是简短的“是啊”和表情符号。

e.en: The family slept in a round {yurta}.
e.zh: 这家人在一座圆形毡房里过夜。

e.en: A decorated {yurta} stood near the summer pasture.
e.zh: 一座装饰过的蒙古包立在夏季牧场旁。

e.en: He was {ywis} a loyal friend.
e.zh: 他确实是一位忠诚的朋友。

e.en: The knight, {ywis}, feared no storm.
e.zh: 那位骑士当然不惧任何风暴。

e.en: The botanist described the forked vein as {ypsiloid} in shape.
e.zh: 植物学家把这条分叉叶脉描述为形似希腊字母Υ。

e.en: A {ypsiloid} mark was carved near the old doorway.
e.zh: 旧门口旁刻着一个Y形的记号。

yrast.t: 核物理中高角动量的最低能态

e.en: The nucleus reached a {yrast} state after the reaction.
e.zh: 反应后，原子核达到了高角动量下的最低能态。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {yrast} band of the isotope.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了该同位素的yrast能带。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {ytterbia} and other rare-earth oxides.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量氧化镱和其他稀土氧化物。

e.en: Pure {ytterbia} is useful in some specialized ceramic materials.
e.zh: 纯氧化镱可用于一些专门的陶瓷材料。

e.en: The chemist prepared an {ytterbic} salt for analysis.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种含三价镱的盐用于分析。

e.en: An {ytterbic} solution showed a faint color under the lamp.
e.zh: 这种镱溶液在灯下显出淡淡的颜色。

e.en: The museum labeled the dark mineral as {ytterbite}.
e.zh: 博物馆把这块深色矿物标为硅铍钇矿。

e.en: Early chemists studied {ytterbite} for its rare-earth elements.
e.zh: 早期化学家研究硅铍钇矿，以寻找其中的稀土元素。

e.en: The alloy contains a small amount of {ytterbium}.
e.zh: 这种合金含有少量镱。

e.en: Scientists use {ytterbium} atoms in advanced atomic clocks.
e.zh: 科学家在先进原子钟中使用镱原子。

e.en: The paper discussed several {ytterbous} compounds.
e.zh: 论文讨论了几种含二价镱的化合物。

e.en: An {ytterbous} ion can behave differently from an ytterbic ion.
e.zh: 亚镱离子的表现可能不同于三价镱离子。

e.en: Engineers added {yttria} to stabilize the zirconia ceramic.
e.zh: 工程师加入氧化钇来稳定氧化锆陶瓷。

e.en: The mineral was processed to extract {yttria}.
e.zh: 这种矿石经过处理以提取氧化钇。

yttrialite.t: 钇硅酸盐矿物；钇榍石类矿

e.en: The geologist identified a grain of {yttrialite} in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩石中认出一粒钇硅酸盐矿物。

e.en: Rare {yttrialite} crystals were found in the pegmatite.
e.zh: 伟晶岩中发现了罕见的钇硅酸盐晶体。

e.en: The lab measured the properties of a {yttric} oxide sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了一份氧化钇样品的性质。

e.en: A {yttric} compound can improve some ceramic coatings.
e.zh: 含钇化合物能改善某些陶瓷涂层。

e.en: They collected {yttriferous} ore from the old mine.
e.zh: 他们从旧矿井采集了含钇矿石。

e.en: The region is known for several {yttriferous} minerals.
e.zh: 该地区以几种含钇矿物而闻名。

e.en: The old textbook mentioned a hypothetical {yttrious} compound.
e.zh: 那本旧教材提到了一种假想的低价钇化合物。

e.en: Few modern papers use the term {yttrious} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有现代论文使用“亚钇的”这个说法。

yttrogarnet.t: 钇铝石榴石；含钇石榴石

e.en: The laser used a synthetic {yttrogarnet} crystal.
e.zh: 这台激光器使用了一块合成钇铝石榴石晶体。

e.en: A transparent {yttrogarnet} can serve as an optical material.
e.zh: 透明的钇铝石榴石可用作光学材料。

e.en: The collector bought a small specimen of {yttrotantalite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块钇钽矿标本。

e.en: Geologists found {yttrotantalite} in the rare-metal deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在稀有金属矿床中发现了钇钽矿。

yttrotungstite.t: 钇钨矿；含钇钨酸盐矿物

e.en: The yellow crust was later identified as {yttrotungstite}.
e.zh: 这层黄色外壳后来被鉴定为钇钨矿。

e.en: Samples of {yttrotungstite} are uncommon outside mineral collections.
e.zh: 钇钨矿样品在矿物收藏之外并不常见。

e.en: She added strips of {yuba} to the hot soup.
e.zh: 她把几条腐竹放进热汤里。

e.en: Dried {yuba} should be soaked before cooking.
e.zh: 干腐竹烹调前应该先泡软。

e.en: The stew was thickened with grated {yuca}.
e.zh: 这道炖菜用磨碎的木薯增稠。

e.en: Fried {yuca} is often served with a spicy sauce.
e.zh: 炸木薯常配辣酱一起上桌。

yue.t: 粤语；中国南方方言之一

e.en: Many people in Guangzhou speak {Yue} at home.
e.zh: 广州许多人在家说粤语。

e.en: The linguist compared {Yue} with other Chinese varieties.
e.zh: 语言学家把粤语同其他汉语变体作比较。

yuekin.t: 月琴，一种中国弹拨乐器

e.en: The musician played a bright melody on the {yuekin}.
e.zh: 那位乐师用月琴弹出明亮的旋律。

e.en: An old {yuekin} hung on the wall of the studio.
e.zh: 一把旧月琴挂在工作室的墙上。

yugawaralite.t: 汤河原沸石，一种沸石矿物

e.en: The cavity contained delicate crystals of {yugawaralite}.
e.zh: 空洞里含有精细的汤河原沸石晶体。

e.en: Collectors prize {yugawaralite} from certain Japanese localities.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视某些日本产地的汤河原沸石。
